units.source_text: 一口气跑到建勋神社宽阔的前院时，我已是汗流泱背了。

en.t: By the time I had run in one breath to the broad forecourt of Kenkun Shrine, sweat was already streaming down my back.

units.source_text: 石阶联结着正面的前殿。

en.t: The stone steps led up to the front hall directly ahead.

units.source_text: 向石阶伸延的是一片平坦的石板地。

en.t: A flat expanse of stone paving stretched toward the steps.

units.source_text: 从左右低低地朗曲的松树伏在神路的上空。

en.t: Low, bending pines from either side hung over the shrine path.

units.source_text: 右侧是木壁色的破旧的神社办公室，大门上挂着"命运研究所"的牌子。

en.t: On the right stood a shabby shrine office the color of wooden walls, with a sign reading "Institute of Fate" hanging over the gate.

units.source_text: 从办公室到前殿途中，有一间白泥灰墙的仓库，

en.t: On the way from the office to the front hall, there was a storehouse with white plaster walls,

units.source_text: 从这里开始连续种植着稀疏的杉树，

en.t: and from there a sparse line of cedars had been planted one after another,

units.source_text: 冰冷的蛋白色云朵饱含着沉痛的光，

en.t: while cold, egg-white clouds were heavy with a sorrowful light,

units.source_text: 在这不平静的天空下，可以环视到京都西郊的群山。

en.t: and beneath that uneasy sky, one could look out over the mountains on Kyoto's western outskirts.
